ChangeLog: V1.3 Changelog -> Added Auto TOP on the Auto page. -> Added Auto UI and Auto Highest Form setting to Auto Transform. -> Added Slot Configuration Loader in Settings page. -> Added Auto Buy Items on the Auto page. -> Added Auto Buy XP on the Misc page. -> Added Secondary Form setting to Auto Transform. -> Added Retreat On Hit setting in Combat Section. -> Added Safe Use setting to Auto Item. -> Added Server Hop Players slider and Server Hop Modes: Less Than, More Than, Smallest Server and Biggest Server. -> Added Survival section in Auto Page and added Knocked Down Retreat toggle in it. -> Added Invite Everyone button in Misc page. -> Added Distance slider to Auto Collect Drops. -> Added "World Selector" to World Teleport dropdown. -> Improved No Slow. -> Auto Transform now waits until you can perform actions again before bringing you back into combat. Previously, it could bring you back while you still couldn't attack or use moves. -> Auto Quest and Auto Raid webhooks now show your level. -> Knocked down teleports now have priority over Auto Transform, Auto Senzu and Auto Item teleports so they don't fight. -> Fixed Auto Quest with some Other World quests like Bunz one, Auto Quest Will now get you onto Pads first. -> Fixed rare case where Auto Charge could get stuck charging forever. -> Fixed Wait For Auto Quest setting of Auto Next World not waiting for Auto Quest to start in auto load configs. All Scripts -> All scripts load time has been reduced by caching, especially noticeable in slower connections and takes effect after the first execution. Also improves script loading reliability. -> All scripts now use GitHub as primary loading for better reliability. -> Added Dark Mode setting to Disable 3D Rendering in FSR and Dragon Soul scripts.
